status: declared; monitor and invariant states are probed at publish time by scripts/ways-of-working-probe.py
provenance: Joe 2026-11-02: declared ways of working must show up in Cascade Live with exactly which are off, broken or not working; the backlog-understood failure stays visible until fixed. Narration: holes/excursions/apex-thesis-narration-2026-11-02.md

ways.name: Nothing is accepted on say-so
ways.problem: An assertion severed from its derivation cannot be checked, learned from, or recovered.
ways.invariant: Every reviewed change carries a warrant whose shas match the diff; a run without one is the dirty tree, not a veto.

ways.name: Everything that exists is on the map, or it is a hole
ways.problem: Knowing what exists and its state, with provenance, at stack scale.
ways.invariant: Every hyperedge section reads OK and the five standards (regenerates, evidence, reconstitution, honest holes, composed) hold.

ways.name: A send is not a receipt
ways.problem: The loop's human and stakeholder edges are where learning silently dies.
ways.invariant: Every bell has a return path and every reply to the operator carries intent marks that can be read back.

ways.name: A selection gives a reason over ways of selecting, and a click can be refused
ways.problem: Deciding what to do next, accountably, under uncertainty, with the goals themselves formable.
ways.invariant: No outer-then-inner click runs unless the selection report names the way of selecting that won and what it would have proposed otherwise.

ways.name: All files are committed and pushed; no mess is left in the repos
ways.problem: Uncommitted and unpushed work is invisible to every other participant, cannot be reviewed, and is lost on the next disk failure; a dirty tree also stops the click loop's preflight.
ways.invariant: Every repo under ~/code with an upstream has no untracked or modified files and no unpushed commits.
built: futon3/inbox-zero-lib (turn-end promotion in the futon3c JVM)

ways.name: Every open item is placed under a way of working, or declared retired
ways.problem: Thousands of backlogged items that nobody has read are a pile, not a plan; neither the operator nor the War Machine can select from a pile.
ways.invariant: The draw pile is empty: every mission, excursion and ticket on the stack has a placement (wing, action, finish) or a retirement, and the placements are on a committed path.

ways.name: All operator turns are logged to the evidence landscape
ways.problem: Without the operator's turns in the record, nothing an agent did can be traced to what was asked.
ways.invariant: Every operator turn appears in the evidence landscape (Joe 2026-08-28: the fundamental invariant; everything else builds from it).
